# The subalgebra generated by one observable

The module `PhyslibAlpha.ProbabilisticTheory.JordanOrderUnit.Power.GeneratedByOne`, [PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean): 5 declarations, 2 with a docstring.

> The span `J[a]` of the powers of an observable contains `1` and is Jordan-closed.

## i. Overview

> The span `J[a]` of the powers of an observable `a` contains `1` and `a` and is closed under the
> Jordan product.

## ii. Key results

> - `JordanAlgebra.generatedByOne` : the span of the powers of `a`.
> - `JordanAlgebra.mul_mem_generatedByOne` : it is closed under the Jordan product.

## iv. References

> * None.

## A. The generated submodule

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.generatedByOne`**, a def, [line 52](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean#L52).

> The subalgebra generated by `1` and `a`, as an ℝ-submodule: the span of all Jordan powers of
> `a` (which already includes `a^{[0]} = 1`).

```lean
def generatedByOne (a : E) : Submodule ℝ E
```

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.jpow_mem_generatedByOne`**, a lemma, [line 55](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean#L55).

```lean
lemma jpow_mem_generatedByOne (a : E) (n : ℕ) : a ^[n] ∈ generatedByOne a
```

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.one_mem_generatedByOne`**, a lemma, [line 59](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean#L59).

```lean
lemma one_mem_generatedByOne (a : E) : (1 : E) ∈ generatedByOne a
```

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.self_mem_generatedByOne`**, a lemma, [line 64](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean#L64).

```lean
lemma self_mem_generatedByOne (a : E) : a ∈ generatedByOne a
```

## B. Closure under the Jordan product

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.mul_mem_generatedByOne`**, a lemma, [line 71](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/GeneratedByOne.lean#L71).

> `J[a]` is closed under the Jordan product.

```lean
lemma mul_mem_generatedByOne (a : E) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ generatedByOne a)
    (hy : y ∈ generatedByOne a) : x * y ∈ generatedByOne a
```
